name: The Ravine
description: Open-source multi-agent artificial-life sandbox where humans and AI agents live in one world under the same rules. Behaviour emerges from learning and adaptation, not from scripts.

principles: The player is one of the creatures: every rule applies equally to humans, AI agents and simulated creatures.
Rules are data: simulation constants live in SimulationRules.
Behaviour emerges from adaptation and learning, not from scripted roles.

agents.brain: SharedHierarchicalBrain: one per colony; coordinator LSTM picks a goal, executor LSTM picks an action; online reward-weighted truncated BPTT, TD critic, random network distillation novelty reward
agents.observation: InputVectorizer builds the input vector from perception; see docs/map/ai.md
agents.evolution: GeneticParameters per agent, partner selection and crossover in EvolutionService

telemetry.simulationLog: optional CSV with world and colony rows

externalAgentInterface.note: Connecting external AI agents as creatures with the same perception and actions as simulated agents is planned. Until then agents can only read the source and documentation.
